senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) marital relation, intermarriage, wedlock (connubium).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31b:7">Ab. Zar. 31ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>משום ח׳</he> as a guard against intermarriage (between Jews and gentiles).
Yeb. 76ᵃ לית להו ח׳ they have no connubium (a marriage with them is not legally recognized); a. e.—בית ח׳ additional rooms for the young couple in the bridegroom’s paternal house.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:4">B. Bath. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 98b:5">98ᵇ</cite>).
